_doc: Single source of truth for solver harnesses. run_one.sh reads this via conf.py (conf.py falls back to config.yaml:solvers only if this file is absent). Each entry: key = the arm name shown in the dashboard (MUST match web/index.html HARNESSES). guided=false -> objective has the '## PR's solution' section STRIPPED (blind FormulaCode: discover the optimization). guided=true -> full problem.md incl. the author's merged patch, asked to beat it. compile='cpu' -> the arm must leave its edit under data/pr_<n>/files/<arm>/ (a vllm/ tree overlay) and that overlay must compile + run on the CPU mirror image (templates/Dockerfile.cpu-wheel); pipeline/apply_ai_solutions.py applies it and re-measures with the SAME instrument (bench.py + parse_workload.py). The runner invokes:  <cmd> "<objective>"  inside a copy of the base_sha tree; the command edits ./vllm and exits. NOTE: claude's --allowedTools is variadic, so `-p` must be the LAST token of cmd: the runner appends "<objective>" and it becomes -p's argument.
